# meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_rule (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Organization Policies Global Firewall Rule` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_rule" "example" {
  organization_id                      = "123456"
  description                          = "This is rule 1"
  enabled                              = true
  name                                 = "Allow developers"
  policy                               = "deny"
  priority                             = 1
  ruleset_id                           = "32"
  destinations_criteria_address_ranges = ["1.1.1.1"]
  destinations_match_criteria          = ["addressRanges"]
  sources_criteria_address_ranges      = ["1.1.1.1"]
  sources_match_criteria               = ["addressRanges"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall rule
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID
- `policy` (String) Rule policy - allow or deny traffic
  - Choices: `allow`, `deny`
- `priority` (Number) Rule priority (lower numbers = higher priority)
- `ruleset_id` (String) Firewall ruleset ID to associate the rule with

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the firewall rule
- `destinations_criteria_address_ranges` (List of String) Address ranges or addresses
- `destinations_criteria_appliance_vlans` (Attributes List) Appliance VLANs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_criteria_appliance_vlans))
- `destinations_criteria_application_categories` (Attributes List) Application categories (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_criteria_application_categories))
- `destinations_criteria_applications` (Attributes List) Applications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_criteria_applications))
- `destinations_criteria_policy_object_groups` (Attributes List) Policy object groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_criteria_policy_object_groups))
- `destinations_criteria_policy_objects` (Attributes List) Policy objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_criteria_policy_objects))
- `destinations_criteria_ports` (List of String) Port numbers or ranges
- `destinations_criteria_services` (Attributes List) Protocol and port services (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_criteria_services))
- `destinations_match_criteria` (Set of String) Destination match criteria types
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled
- `sources_criteria_address_ranges` (List of String) Address ranges or addresses
- `sources_criteria_appliance_vlans` (Attributes List) Appliance VLANs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources_criteria_appliance_vlans))
- `sources_criteria_policy_object_groups` (Attributes List) Policy object groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources_criteria_policy_object_groups))
- `sources_criteria_policy_objects` (Attributes List) Policy objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources_criteria_policy_objects))
- `sources_criteria_ports` (List of String) Port numbers or ranges
- `sources_match_criteria` (Set of String) Source match criteria types

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_rule.example
  identity = {
    organization_id = "<organization_id>"
    id              = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_rule.example
  id = "<organization_id>,<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import meraki_organization_policies_global_firewall_rule.example "<organization_id>,<id>"
```
